name: rab-world
title: World Toolkit
description: Tools for world records, manifests, signals, and beacons.

items.name: beacon-manifest
items.title: Add Beacon Manifest
items.description: Creates an empty beacon-owned manifest beside an existing beacon.json, without project registration or project identity.

items.name: manifest
items.title: Add Manifest
items.description: Creates an empty manifest from the existing project inventory shape.

items.name: world
items.title: New World
items.description: Creates a named world for this computer/user instance under .rab/worlds, using the shared memory and template owners.

items.name: signal
items.title: Add Signal
items.description: Creates a signal folder's settings, contract and README from its template.

items.name: world-manifest
items.title: Add World Manifest
items.description: Creates an empty manifest.json in an existing folder without project or beacon requirements.

items.name: audit-beacons
items.title: Audit Beacons
items.description: Read-only current-format check of beacon records at an explicit beacon root.

items.name: audit-signals
items.title: Audit Signals
items.description: Read-only current-format check of signal settings and contracts at an explicit beacon root.

items.name: beacons
items.title: Create Folder Beacon
items.description: Creates beacon.json in a project-relative folder for an updater to discover.

items.name: scanner
items.title: World Scanner
items.description: Indexes beacons and child signals under an explicit root and toolkit paths registered in world settings.

items.name: search-feedback
items.title: Count Search Use
items.description: Increment the used counter for a returned World Search item.

items.name: watcher
items.title: World Watcher
items.description: Saves a watcher file that watches only registered beacons; no watcher starts automatically.

items.name: world-hands
items.title: World Hands
items.description: Returns the available hands owned by this world toolkit and their input contracts through Box discovery.

items.name: world-search
items.title: World Search
items.description: Search enabled beacon manifests in parallel, returning matches in beacon priority order.
